props.name: actions
props.description: Action buttons rendered after the body.

props.name: avatar
props.description: Avatar rendered in the leading slot (loses to `icon`).

props.name: close
props.description:
Show a close button. `true` renders the default, partial `ButtonProps`
customize it, `false` hides it.

props.name: closeIcon
props.description: Iconify name for the close button. Defaults to `appConfig.ui.icons.close`.

props.name: description
props.description: Description text. Overridden by the `description` slot.

props.name: icon
props.description: Iconify name rendered in the leading slot.

props.name: progress
props.type: boolean | { color?: keyof VyuiColorRegistry | ((progress: number) => keyof VyuiColorRegistry | undefined) | undefined; } | undefined
props.description:
Show a thin countdown bar that drains as the auto-dismiss timer runs.
Tracks `ToastRoot`'s `progress`, so it pauses while the stack is expanded
and is hidden when auto-dismiss is off.

`true` inherits the toast `color`; an object overrides just the bar color,
either fixed (`{ color: 'success' }`) or a function of the remaining
fraction (`1` → `0`) so the bar recolors as it drains.

props.name: stacked
props.description:
Sonner-style stacking: toasts collapse into an overlapping pile and fan out
when expanded — tap any toast to toggle. Requires the surrounding
`<ToastProvider>` and a `<ToastViewport>` anchored to match `stackFrom`.

props.name: stackFrom
props.description:
Which edge the stack is pinned to — must match the `ToastViewport`
`position`. `top` fans downward, `bottom` upward. Only used when `stacked`.

props.name: swipe
props.description: Enable swipe-to-dismiss (fling the toast away to close it).

props.name: swipeDirection
props.description:
Directions a swipe may dismiss in. `horizontal` (default) flings either
way; `left` / `right` constrain it. Only used when `swipe`.

props.name: title
props.description: Title text. Overridden by the `title` slot.

slots.name: leading
slots.description: Receives `iconColor` so custom icons can match the toast's resolved color.
